attributes.action: Stop retrospective settlement changes for refugees and remove hidden Footnote 14
attributes.additional_details: The Home Office's March 2026 rules (HC 951) explicitly guaranteed that anyone claiming asylum before 2 March 2026 would retain their 5-year path to settlement. However, the 2 November 2026 Earned Settlement paper quietly broke this promise in Footnote 14 (page 34). This hidden U-turn retrospectively forces existing refugees onto 10-to-20-year routes. This unjust retrospection destroys public trust and unfairly penalises working families relying on essential Universal Credit top-ups.
